description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Flat' class, which extends the system's Model class and provides shipping cost calculations for a flat-rate shipping extension in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: A model class for the 'flat' shipping method, providing the getQuote method to compute shipping costs based on configuration and geographic zones.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Retrieves a shipping quote for the flat shipping method based on the provided address, considering geo zones, configuration settings, and costs.
